title: MATHDIAL: A Dialogue Tutoring Dataset with Rich Pedagogical Properties Grounded in Math Reasoning Problems
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a dialogue tutoring dataset and benchmarking LLMs for tutoring math. While it mentions 'Responsible AI' in acknowledgements and briefly references LLMs showing 'similar biases in logical reasoning as humans' from another work, it does not have a substantial component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as its primary contribution.
